definition.players: pseudo_inner.json's bank players (split v1 inner, >= 5 inner games) with their folds
definition.pool: (player, colour): every dumped inner game of that player with that colour (inner_keys.npz colour), ordered by sha256('c10-prereg03|mono|order|{rank}|{game_id}') hex
definition.questions: rounds [0, 31] (32 rounds); every player in player order, colour B then W, k in [5, 10, 15, 20] with k <= pool size: random.Random(int(sha256('c10-prereg03|mono|q|{r}|{player_id}|{colour}|{k}')[:16], 16)).sample(range(pool), k)
definition.why: official competition 2 questions hold 5/10/15/20 games of one colour each (AIdea data page, docs/DATA.md); the registered inner pseudo-questions and the local validation are mixed-colour
